articles.title_en: International Migration Responses to Modern Europe’s Most Destructive Earthquake: Messina and Reggio Calabria, 1908
articles.title_cn: 国际移民对现代欧洲最具破坏性地震的回应：墨西拿与雷焦卡拉布里亚，1908年
articles.abstract_en: The Messina-Reggio Calabria Earthquake (1908) was one of the most devastating natural disasters in modern European history. It occurred when overseas mass emigration from southern Italy was at its peak and international borders were open, making emigration a readily available option for relief. We find that the earthquake had no large positive impact on emigration on average. There were, however, heterogeneous responses, with a more positive effect where agricultural day laborers comprised a larger share of the labor force, suggesting that attachment to the land limited an emigration response.
articles.abstract_cn: 墨西拿-雷焦卡拉布里亚地震（1908年）是现代欧洲历史上最具破坏性的自然灾害之一。它发生在意大利南部海外大规模移民达到顶峰且国际边界开放的时期，使得移民成为现成的救济选择。我们发现，地震平均而言并未对移民产生大的正向影响。然而，存在异质性回应，在农业日工占劳动力比例较大的地区，正向效应更为显著，这表明对土地的依附限制了移民回应。

articles.title_en: Voting Rights and Media Sentiment: Evidence from Early Suffrage States
articles.title_cn: 投票权与媒体情绪：来自早期选举权州的证据
articles.abstract_en: Did women’s suffrage affect media sentiment toward voting rights and narratives about women more generally? I identify pro- and anti-suffrage language using publications that explicitly argued for or against early voting reform. I then measure media sentiment using language in newspapers and topic modeling to identify common themes about either suffrage or women. Difference-in-differences estimates show that newspaper coverage of suffrage increased when women won the vote but then declined below baseline. Newspaper sentiment moved in opposition to the status quo, with average sentiment becoming more anti-suffrage. Lastly, suffrage increased discussions of women in politics for several years.
articles.abstract_cn: 女性选举权是否影响了媒体对投票权的情绪以及更普遍地对女性的叙述？我通过明确支持或反对早期投票改革的出版物来识别支持和反对选举权的语言。然后，我使用报纸中的语言和主题建模来衡量媒体情绪，以识别关于选举权或女性的共同主题。双重差分估计显示，当女性赢得投票权时，报纸对选举权的报道增加，但随后降至基线以下。报纸情绪与现状相反，平均情绪变得更加反对选举权。最后，选举权增加了关于女性参与政治的讨论，持续了数年。

articles.title_en: Large Fires and the Rise of Fire Insurance in Early Twentieth-Century Japan
articles.title_cn: 二十世纪初日本的大火灾与火灾保险的兴起
articles.abstract_en: We explore the role that large fires played in the early development of the Japanese fire insurance industry. Using a prefecture-level data set spanning 30 years, our econometric analysis shows that large fires led to an increase in new policies and policy renewals, consistent with historical narratives that insurance companies used these events to advertise their business. We also show that this subsequent surge in policies led to more small fires due to arson. Anecdotal evidence suggests that it is more likely to have been due to moral hazard rather than adverse selection.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了大火灾在日本火灾保险业早期发展中所扮演的角色。利用一个覆盖30年的县级数据集，我们的计量经济学分析表明，大火灾导致了新保单和保单续保的增加，这与保险公司利用这些事件进行业务宣传的历史叙述相符。我们还表明，随后保单的激增导致了更多因纵火引起的小火灾。轶事证据表明，这更可能是由于道德风险而非逆向选择所致。

articles.title_en: The Cross of Gold: Brazilian Treasure and the Decline of Portugal
articles.title_cn: 黄金的十字架：巴西财富与葡萄牙的衰落
articles.abstract_en: As late as 1750, Portugal had a high output per head by Western European standards. Yet just a century later, Portugal was this region’s poorest country. In this paper, we show that the discovery of massive quantities of gold in Brazil over the eighteenth century played a key role in the long-run development of Portugal. The country suffered from an economic and political resource curse. A counterfactual based on synthetic control methods suggests that by 1800 Portugal’s GDP per capita was 40 percent lower than it would have been without its endowment of Brazilian gold.
articles.abstract_cn: 直到1750年，葡萄牙的人均产出仍按西欧标准处于较高水平。然而，仅一个世纪后，葡萄牙便成为该地区最贫穷的国家。在本文中，我们表明，十八世纪巴西大量黄金的发现对葡萄牙的长期发展起到了关键作用。该国遭受了经济和政治上的资源诅咒。基于合成控制法的反事实分析表明，到1800年，葡萄牙的人均GDP比没有巴西黄金禀赋的情况下低了40%。

articles.title_en: Lottery-Based Elections, Power Monopolization, and Urban Development: The Case of Swiss City-States, 1666–1794
articles.title_cn: 基于抽签的选举、权力垄断与城市发展：瑞士城邦的案例，1666-1794年
articles.abstract_en: Early modern urban parliaments suffered an increasing monopolization of political power that hampered urban development. To combat power monopolization, some Swiss city-states reformed their election systems by randomly selecting political representatives from a pre-elected pool of candidates. We implement a difference-in-differences design and find that lottery-based election systems improved the equality of distribution of political seats within parliaments. Lottery-based elections also had positive effects on trade tax revenues, trade volumes, and infrastructure expenditures. We explain this finding by showing that lottery-based election systems fostered the election of merchants to top political positions.
articles.abstract_cn: 近代早期的城市议会遭受政治权力日益垄断的困扰，这阻碍了城市发展。为对抗权力垄断，一些瑞士城邦通过从预先选出的候选人池中随机抽取政治代表来改革其选举制度。我们采用了双重差分设计，发现基于抽签的选举制度改善了议会内政治席位分配的平等性。基于抽签的选举还对贸易税收收入、贸易量和基础设施支出产生了积极影响。我们通过展示基于抽签的选举制度促进了商人被选入最高政治职位来解释这一发现。

articles.title_en: Creating American Farmland: Governance Institutions and Investment in Agricultural Drainage
articles.title_cn: 创建美国农田：治理机构与农业排水投资
articles.abstract_en: The Corn Belt is famously responsible for the bulk of U.S. corn production, and over half of its production comes from counties that rely on artificial drainage. We trace the history of this extensive investment in farmland and document the importance of a key institutional innovation, the drainage management district, which increased the land value of naturally wet eastern U.S. counties by 20–37 percent ($16.8–18.7 billion in 2020 dollars). While dramatically increasing agricultural productivity, drainage converted more than half of the 215 million acres of wetlands estimated to have existed in the United States at the time of colonization to agriculture.
articles.abstract_cn: 玉米带以承担美国玉米生产的大部分而闻名，其产量超过一半来自依赖人工排水的县。我们追溯了这一大规模农田投资的历史，并记录了一个关键制度创新——排水管理区的重要性，它使美国东部自然湿润县的土地价值增加了20-37%（按2020年美元计算，约16.8-18.7亿美元）。尽管大幅提高了农业生产力，排水将殖民时期估计存在的215百万英亩湿地中超过一半转化为农业用地。

articles.title_en: Institutional Innovation and the Adoption of New Technologies: The Case of Steam
articles.title_cn: 制度创新与新技术的采用：蒸汽技术的案例
articles.abstract_en: This paper documents how the advent of the limited liability corporation contributed to the diffusion of steam technology during Sweden’s industrialization. Using longitudinal establishment-level data, we show that incorporation sharply raised the probability that industrial establishments adopted steam. Incorporation facilitated technology adoption partly by enabling smaller establishments to expand to a greater scale, where the use of steam became feasible. These results highlight that low barriers to incorporation may be an important lever for facilitating the diffusion of new technologies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文记录了有限责任公司的出现如何促进了瑞典工业化期间蒸汽技术的传播。利用纵向的企业层面数据，我们表明公司化显著提高了工业企业采用蒸汽技术的概率。公司化部分地通过使较小规模的企业能够扩大到更大规模，从而使蒸汽的使用变得可行，来促进技术采用。这些结果强调，低门槛的公司化可能是促进新技术传播的重要杠杆。

articles.title_en: Cross-Cultural Trade and the Slave Ship the Bonne Société: Baskets of Goods, Diverse Sellers, and Time Pressure on the African Coast
articles.title_cn: 跨文化贸易与奴隶船“好社会号”：非洲海岸上的商品篮子、多元卖主与时间压力
articles.abstract_en: The eighteenth-century French slave ship the Bonne Société traded bundles of goods in exchange for slaves in Loango. We present detailed evidence from the ship’s trading log that decomposes the goods in the bundle and identifies the European and African merchants selling captives to the ship. Prices steadily increased throughout the captain’s stay in port, and the captain increased the bundle’s price by adding more goods and adding high-priced goods. Sellers participated both as one-shot traders and as repeat traders. These results add a nuanced picture of how this destructive trade worked in practice.
articles.abstract_cn: 十八世纪的法国奴隶船“好社会号”在卢安戈以成捆的商品交换奴隶。我们提供了来自该船贸易日志的详细证据，分解了商品篮中的货物，并识别了向该船出售俘虏的欧洲和非洲商人。在整个船长停留港口期间，价格稳步上涨，船长通过增加更多商品和添加高价商品来提高篮子的价格。卖主既作为一次性交易者，也作为重复交易者参与。这些结果增添了关于这种破坏性贸易在实践中如何运作的细致图景。
